Callout.Name: Traffic Stop Backup
Callout.Message: Officer requesting backup at a traffic stop.
Callout.Advisory: Single officer on scene, driver not complying.

Script.Line: I have one male out of the vehicle and he is compliant.
It is the passenger who is the problem. He will not get out.
I am on the shoulder. Come up on my side.

Lines.Approach: One officer on scene and the driver is not doing what he is told. Get there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
